formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → (∀ a1 : Fin n, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C (fun k1 => decide (k1 = a1)) = false) → (∀ a2 b2 : Fin n, a2 ≠ b2 → ¬ G.Adj a2 b2 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C (fun k2 => decide (k2 = a2 ∨ k2 = b2)) = false) → (∀ j < C.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C C.output j → (∀ w : Fin n, w ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C j 0 → w ∉ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C j 1) ∧ (∀ u : Fin n, u ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C j 0 → ∀ v : Fin n, v ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C j 1 → G.Adj u v) ∧ ((PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C j 0).card ≤ 1 ∨ (PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C j 1).card ≤ 1)) ∧ (∀ F : Finset ℕ, (∀ e ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun e1 : Fin n × Fin n => e1.1 < e1.2 ∧ G.Adj e1.1 e1.2 ∧ PEqualNP.ReadK.readsAtMost C n [e1.1.val, e1.2.val] 1 = true)), ∃ i ∈ F, i < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C C.output i ∧ ((e.1 ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C i 0 ∧ e.2 ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C i 1) ∨ (e.2 ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C i 0 ∧ e.1 ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C i 1))) → ∃ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ F.card ∧ ∀ e3 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun e2 : Fin n × Fin n => e2.1 < e2.2 ∧ G.Adj e2.1 e2.2 ∧ PEqualNP.ReadK.readsAtMost C n [e2.1.val, e2.2.val] 1 = true)), e3.1 ∈ T ∨ e3.2 ∈ T))
plain_statement: It is false that: G has no 4-cycle. C has AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires, false when one vertex is true and when two non-adjacent ones are. (1) For an AND gate reaching the output through OR gates only, the OR-shadows of its inputs (inputs reached downward through ORs only) are disjoint, fully adjacent across, one of size <= 1. (2) If a set F of such gates has, for each read-1 edge a < b (a proof tree (all inputs at an AND gate, one at an OR gate) on a, b reads each at most once), ends in both shadows, at most |F| vertices meet all read-1 edges.
title: It is false that: Graphs with no 4-cycle, AND/OR circuits of fan-in exactly two false on weight one and non-edges: witness ANDs are stars, centres cover read-1
